notes:
Single source of truth for SoCal community college dual-enrollment data.
Editable by hand for emergency fixes between scraper runs.
Refresh via: python3 tools/scrape_college_data.py --apply

colleges.region_label: LA West / South Bay (Santa Monica, Torrance, Inglewood, Hawthorne)
colleges.why: Strong CCAP partnerships across South Bay high schools, 8-unit summer cap, solid online catalog.

colleges.region_label: LA West / Coastal (Santa Monica, West LA, Culver City)
colleges.why: Top UC-transfer college in California. Excellent Cal-GETC coverage and strong online offerings.

colleges.region_label: LA East / San Gabriel Valley (Pasadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Alhambra)
colleges.why: Broad CCAP network, wide online catalog, and strong math/science transfer sequences.

colleges.region_label: LA East / Pomona Valley (Pomona, West Covina, Rowland Heights, Diamond Bar)
colleges.why: Largest community college enrollment in California. Strong articulation with UC/CSU, returning students get 2-course access.

colleges.region_label: LA North / San Fernando Valley (Van Nuys, Chatsworth, Burbank, North Hollywood)
colleges.why: Most accessible dual enrollment in the SFV, strong online options, good CCAP coverage.

colleges.region_label: LA North / Santa Clarita Valley & Antelope Valley (Valencia, Palmdale, Lancaster)
colleges.why: Dedicated dual enrollment office, COC2College pipeline for SCV high schoolers, 7-unit summer cap.

colleges.region_label: Orange County (Anaheim, Huntington Beach, Costa Mesa, Newport Beach)
colleges.why: Highest summer CCAP cap (10 units) in OC, deepest online catalog, accepts statewide enrollment for only $42 one-time fee.

colleges.region_label: Orange County South (Irvine, Mission Viejo, Lake Forest, Laguna Hills)
colleges.why: Highest CCAP unit ceiling in all of SoCal (15 units/term), exceptional STEM sequences, UC Irvine proximity.

colleges.region_label: San Diego County (San Diego, Oceanside, Escondido, El Cajon, Chula Vista)
colleges.why: OUSD 16-Day Summer program covers textbooks, supplies, and transport. Strong dual enrollment infrastructure.

colleges.region_label: Inland Empire (Riverside, San Bernardino, Rancho Cucamonga, Ontario, Temecula)
colleges.why: CCAP covers free textbooks in addition to tuition, strong Cal-GETC breadth course selection.

colleges.region_label: Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Oxnard, Simi Valley, Moorpark)
colleges.why: Strongest dual enrollment program in Ventura County, solid transfer outcomes, good online access.
